The .html files in files/ come from the test-document corpus of xberg (td/vendored/docling), which vendors test data of docling
(https://github.com/DS4SD/docling), MIT License, Copyright (c) 2024 International Business Machines, copied unmodified.
The other html fixtures are synthesised here from cases in xberg's Rust tests (html_declared_charset.rs, html_script_formatting.rs,
html_table_spans.rs, issue_2182_*). Sizes in bytes:
